action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with unstable model ranking (Kendall tau 0.212) and high error correlation (mean 0.84, only 2 independent groups). A robust trimmed mean over the 7 most stable models is the natural fit: it down-weights the tail of the error distribution while avoiding the overfitting risk of fitted weights estimated on only 3 windows. The leader is a seed and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, confirming no further gain is available from re-weighting or re-pooling.
